# awscc_cloudfront_field_level_encryption_profile (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::CloudFront::FieldLevelEncryptionProfile



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the field-level encryption profile.
- `field_level_encryption_profile_config` (Attributes) The configuration of a field-level encryption profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--field_level_encryption_profile_config))
- `field_level_encryption_profile_id` (String) The identifier that CloudFront assigns to the field-level encryption profile.
- `last_modified_time` (String) The time the field-level encryption profile was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--field_level_encryption_profile_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `field_level_encryption_profile_config`

Read-Only:

- `caller_reference` (String) A unique value that identifies the creation request. Caller references are unique within an AWS account and cannot be changed after creation.
- `comment` (String) An optional comment describing the field-level encryption profile.
- `encryption_entities` (Attributes List) The encryption entities of the field-level encryption profile. At least one entity is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--field_level_encryption_profile_config--encryption_entities))
- `name` (String) The name of the field-level encryption profile. Names are unique within an AWS account.

<a id="nestedatt--field_level_encryption_profile_config--encryption_entities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `field_level_encryption_profile_config.encryption_entities`

Read-Only:

- `field_patterns` (List of String) The request-body field names to encrypt. A pattern is either a full field name or leading characters followed by a wildcard (*). Patterns are case-sensitive and must not overlap.
- `provider_id` (String) The provider associated with the public key. The same value must be supplied with the private key for an application to decrypt the data.
- `public_key_id` (String) The identifier of the CloudFront public key used to encrypt the fields that match the patterns.
